'''Spectral cultivators''' are found in parts of the [[Nomad's temple|ruined temple]] under [[Soul Wars]], during the [[Nomad's Requiem]] quest. The cultivators are aggressive and attack using melee.

A [[Salve amulet]] or [[Salve amulet (e)]] is effective when killing Spectral worshippers.
